name: Scout Support
label: Quest
description: Scout Support: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.
Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Quaint. A fresh face for the field work.
Well, let's see what you have then.
